title: Vinyl Play-Count and Turntable Wear
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vinyl:play
| stats count as plays by album
| eventstats sum(plays) as total_plays
| eval stylus_hours=round(total_plays*0.35,1)
| sort - plays
description: Counts how often each record is played and estimates total stylus hours, hinting when the needle needs replacing.
value: Tracking plays both surfaces your true favourites and protects your records by timing stylus changes before they wear grooves.
implementation: Log plays (NFC tap or app) into `index=personal`; review play counts and cumulative stylus hours.
visualization: Bar chart of play count by album with a stylus-hours total.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often you play each record and hints when the turntable needle needs replacing to protect them.
